heading.title: Of Offences Relating to Documents and to Property Marks

article.title: Making or possession of any instrument for counterfeiting a property mark
article.content: Whoever makes or has in his possession any die, plate or other instrument for the purpose of counterfeiting a property mark, or has in his possession a property mark for the purpose of denoting that any goods belong to a person to whom they do not belong, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to three years, or with fine, or with both.
article.html:
348Making or possession of any instrument for counterfeiting a property mark

Section 348 · Chapter XVIII · Of property marks

Whoever makes or has in his possession any die, plate or other instrument for the purpose of counterfeiting a property mark, or has in his possession a property mark for the purpose of denoting that any goods belong to a person to whom they do not belong, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to three years, or with fine, or with both.
